sentence_stem: If you send me the address,
correct_completion: I will come to your house after school.
full_sentence: If you send me the address, I will come to your house after school.

options.text: I went to the shop yesterday.
options.why_wrong: This describes a past event, but a conditional clause needs a result that depends on the condition.
This is unrelated to the condition, so it does not complete the if-clause.

options.text: I was at home last night.
options.why_wrong: This is a past statement and does not give a future result of the condition.

options.text: I will come to your house after school.

explanation: The 'if' clause describes a possible future condition, so the main clause needs 'will' with a future result. Turkish speakers may use a suffix-based future form here, but English needs a separate auxiliary verb.
